Manage a Library of Books using Structures
Problem Statement:
You are developing a system to manage a library of books. Each book has three attributes: title, author, and year of publication. Your task is to create a structure to define a book, store information for n books, and then print the details of all the books in a formatted way.

You need to declare and define a structure Book and dynamically allocate memory to store details of multiple books.

Input:
The first line contains an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 100), representing the number of books.
The next n lines contain a string title, a string author, and an integer year separated by spaces, which represent the title, author, and year of publication for each book.

Output:
Print all the books in the format: Title: , Author: , Year: for each book.
input_spec:

output_spec: Print all the books in the format: Title: , Author: , Year: for each book.
constraints:
Each string (title or author) will not exceed 100 characters.
The year will be between 1800 and 2024.
You must use structures to manage the book information.
Dynamically allocate memory to store the list of books.
